# MyFestivo — LLMs.txt

> MyFestivo is a college event management platform built for student organizers and participants in India.

## About

MyFestivo is the all-in-one platform for college fests, cultural events, technical hackathons, workshops, and sports competitions. It enables students to discover events, register individually or in teams, and receive QR-based entry passes. Organizers can create and manage events, track registrations, and restrict access to verified college-domain emails.

Built by students at SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Chennai, India.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://myfestivo.live/) — Landing page, platform overview, features
- [Browse Events](https://myfestivo.live/events) — Discover and filter college events
- [Create Account](https://myfestivo.live/signup) — Register as a student organizer or participant
- [Sign In](https://myfestivo.live/login) — Access your account
- [Site Map](https://myfestivo.live/sitemap-page) — Complete site navigation

## Authenticated Features (require login)

- Dashboard — Manage your registrations and hosted events
- Profile — Update college email for intra-college event access
- Friends — Connect with other students on the platform
- Create Event — Host a new college event with sub-events and team registration

## Contact

- Email: myfestivo@gmail.com
- Operated by: MyFestivo Team, SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Chennai, India

## Technical Notes

- Framework: Next.js (App Router)
- Deployment: Firebase / Netlify
- Authentication: Firebase Auth (email/password + Google OAuth)
- Database: Firestore
- Public pages: `/`, `/events`, `/login`, `/signup`, `/sitemap-page`, `/sitemap.xml`, `/robots.txt`
- Private pages (require authentication): `/dashboard`, `/profile`, `/friends`, `/admin`, `/events/create`

## Content Policy

MyFestivo content is intended for college students and educational institutions in India. Event listings are created by verified student organizers. Personal data is protected and not shared publicly.
